name: Joined Stone
description: Pour qi into a laid stone until the stone and the maker beat to the same pulse.

name: Fused Plate
description: Fuse a plate of formation to the maker's own qi so that a blow must break both at once.

name: Braided Cord
description: Braid a cord of formation lines with a cord of the maker's qi and draw it round the foe.

name: Braided Flare
description: Flare braided marks together so the wave carries both the array's charge and the maker's own.

name: Joined Seal
description: Seal a foe's qi with a mark that draws on the maker's own breath to stay shut.

name: Weft Hold
description: Weave a weft of qi through the array and press it down on every foe in its threads.

name: Weave Stride
description: Step along a braided line and let the array and the body move the same pace.

name: Joined Array
description: Lay an array wired straight to the maker's circulation so that it answers every breath.

name: Weft Lattice
description: Hold a woven lattice that turns each blow along threads fed by the maker's qi.

name: Joined Draw
description: Draw a striking force into the array and carry it on into the maker's reserves.

name: Living Array
description: streams: Formation + Qi; Pour the maker's own qi through the array so that it moves and strikes like a living body.

name: Wedded Stone
description: Wed a stone to the maker's thought so that it charges at a thought alone.

name: Wedded Plate
description: Raise a plate that moves wherever the maker's mind turns and meets the blow before it lands.

name: Threaded Cord
description: Thread a cord through the foe's qi and guide it by thought to wherever it will hold best.

name: Mind Stone
description: Set a stone that carries the maker's attention and reports what it feels in plain thought.

name: Wedded Flare
description: Flare the wedded marks by a single thought so that the wave breaks exactly where the maker intends.

name: Thread Seal
description: Draw a thread of mind through a foe's seal and close it by thought.

name: Wedded Hold
description: Press down on the foe's qi with an array that follows each turn of the foe's thought.

name: Wedded Thread
description: Pull the body along a thread of thought laid ahead to the next mark.

name: Wedded Array
description: Lay an array whose lines answer to the maker's thought and to no one else's.

name: Mind Lattice
description: Hold a lattice of thought that tells the maker what every foe within it intends to do.

name: Wedded Mend
description: Guide the array by thought to close each ally's wounds and clear the taint from them.

name: Soul Lattice
description: streams: Formation + Soul; Weave the maker's soul into the lattice so that it binds and strikes at the maker's will.
